name: workflow_update
description: Replace an existing workflow entirely. Pass the id of the workflow to update and the complete replacement workflow JSON — same shape as the UI creates and the HTTP API accepts. Always call workflow_get first to read the current state. The workflow.id inside the JSON must match the id parameter.

id.description: ID of the workflow to update (must already exist)

workflow.description: Complete replacement workflow JSON. Required fields: id (must match the id parameter), name, nodes, edges. All fields are replaced — this is not a patch.
